build: python3 -m compileall -q scripts/continuity scripts/continuity_cli.py scripts/gauntlet_policy.py scripts/rtk_control.py tests/continuity tests/gauntlet tests/pi tests/rtk
docs: python3 -m compileall -q scripts/continuity scripts/continuity_cli.py scripts/gauntlet_policy.py scripts/rtk_control.py tests/continuity tests/gauntlet tests/pi tests/rtk
coverage: mkdir -p .qa-artifacts/continuity-coverage && python3 -m trace --count --summary --missing --ignore-dir "$PREFIX/lib/python3.14" --coverdir .qa-artifacts/continuity-coverage --module unittest discover -s tests/continuity -p 'test_*.py'

mkdir -p .qa-artifacts/pi-gauntlet-coverage && python3 -m trace --count --summary --missing --ignore-dir "$PREFIX/lib/python3.14" --coverdir .qa-artifacts/pi-gauntlet-coverage --module unittest tests.gauntlet.test_policy tests.pi.test_adapter

mkdir -p .qa-artifacts/rtk-coverage && python3 -m trace --count --summary --missing --ignore-dir "$PREFIX/lib/python3.14" --coverdir .qa-artifacts/rtk-coverage --module unittest tests.rtk.test_policy tests.rtk.test_control
